docs.text: --- UID: NF:wingdi.CreatePenIndirect title: CreatePenIndirect function (wingdi.h) description: The CreatePenIndirect function creates a logical cosmetic pen that has the style, width, and color specified in a structure. helpviewer_keywords: ["CreatePenIndirect","CreatePenIndirect function [Windows GDI]","_win32_CreatePenIndirect","gdi.createpenindirect","wingdi/CreatePenIndirect"] old-location: gdi\createpenindirect.htm tech.root: gdi ms.assetid: 638c0294-9a8f-44ed-a791-1be152cd92dd ms.date: 12/05/2018 ms.keywords: CreatePenIndirect, CreatePenIndirect function [Windows GDI], _win32_CreatePenIndirect, gdi.createpenindirect, wingdi/CreatePenIndirect req.header: wingdi.h req.include-header: Windows.h req.target-type: Windows req.target-min-winverclnt: Windows 2000 Professional [desktop apps only] req.target-min-winversvr: Windows 2000 Server [desktop apps only] req.kmdf-ver: req.umdf-ver: req.ddi-compliance: req.unicode-ansi: req.idl: req.max-support: req.namespace: req.assembly: req.type-library: req.lib: Gdi32.lib req.dll: Gdi32.dll req.irql: targetos: Windows req.typenames: req.redist: ms.custom: 19H1 f1_keywords: - CreatePenIndirect - wingdi/CreatePenIndirect dev_langs: - c++ topic_type: - APIRef - kbSyntax api_type: - DllExport api_location: - gdi32.dll - Ext-MS-Win-GDI-Internal-Desktop-L1-1-0.dll - GDI32Full.dll api_name: - CreatePenIndirect --- # CreatePenIndirect function ## -description The CreatePenIndirect function creates a logical cosmetic pen that has the style, width, and color specified in a structure. ## -parameters ### -param plpen [in] Pointer to a LOGPEN structure that specifies the pen's style, width, and color. ## -returns If the function succeeds, the return value is a handle that identifies a logical cosmetic pen. If the function fails, the return value is NULL. ## -remarks After an application creates a logical pen, it can select that pen into a device context by calling the SelectObject function. After a pen is selected into a device context, it can be used to draw lines and curves. When you no longer need the pen, call the DeleteObject function to delete it. ## -see-also CreatePen DeleteObject ExtCreatePen GetObject LOGPEN Pen Functions Pens Overview RGB SelectObject
